slug: 2026-05-04 The World's Most Needed AI Governance Framework Doesn't Exist Yet. Africa Should Build It

facts.fact: Op-ed by Zuria Nagadya says Rwanda has a fully approved national AI policy; no date given, so dated by publication (2026-05-04).

Op-ed says a Responsible AI Office sits in Rwanda's Ministry of ICT and Innovation and the Rwanda Information Society Authority is the named implementing body; no date given, so dated by publication (2026-05-04).
